children: Needham started off coverage on Victoria's Secret
with a Buy rating on its view that the retailer is only in the early innings of a multi-year turnaround.
Analyst Tom Nikic pointed to improvements to the Victoria's Secret
management team, product assortment, and the marketing upside. Notably, Nikic and his team think the VSXY's EPS can double over the next five years.
As for the near term, strong quarter-to-date channel checks and lower promotions have Nikic calling Victoria's Secret

Looking ahead, the company is seen as being a beneficiary of increased adoption of GLP-1 weight loss medicines as slimmed-down women shop for new clothes. All in, we view this as a compelling momentum name heading into 2027
Needham assigned a price target of $106 on VSXY based on a 16X multiple to its FY28 EPS estimate. The PT assumes mid-single-digit revenue growth the next two years and EBIT margin expansion.
Shares of VSXY are up more than 60% on a year-to-date basis, but the Seeking Alpha Quant Rating is still flashing Strong Buy.
